html:
Made for the people who answer to head office

If you work in compliance, procurement or ESG at a multinational, your problem is rarely the disposal itself — it is the evidence. Your Brazilian operation has to dispose of IT assets and electronics in Brazil, under Brazilian law; the documentation has to satisfy people who will never visit São Paulo: group auditors, CSRD reporting teams, Scope 3 and supplier due diligence questionnaires. Ecobraz sells and performs the service in Brazil — and builds the documentation to be read, and verified, anywhere.

What we do

  • Corporate collection with certified destination — scheduled pick-up of IT assets, electronics and appliances at corporate sites across Greater São Paulo, with operations in other Brazilian regions assessed case by case. Corporate solutions
  • Data sanitisation and physical media destruction — recorded per media item, as scoped. Sanitisation · Physical destruction
  • Decommissioning projects — IT estates, data centres, branches and stores, run to a schedule with inventory and chain of custody. Data centre decommissioning
  • Reverse logistics programmes — recurring flows for manufacturers, importers, marketplaces and insurers. Reverse logistics

The three questions your auditor will ask

  1. Can you prove the destination of each asset? Whoever buys a scrap batch has no obligation to document anything. Under Brazil's National Solid Waste Policy, the waste generator's responsibility is shared — it does not travel with the lorry.
  2. Who answers if a data-bearing drive surfaces where it should not? The LGPD — Brazil's data protection law, the local counterpart to the GDPR — asks for your company, not for the buyer of the batch.
  3. Would the paperwork you hold survive an audit? A certificate that cannot be verified relies on trust — and audits exist precisely so that nothing has to rely on trust.

The evidence system — free for every client, no contract

Every collection generates proof at origin: photos and weights recorded at pick-up, the fiscal note (NF) and waste transport manifest (MTR), and a final destination certificate (CDF) where applicable — organised per collection, under your company's Brazilian registration (CNPJ), in the Ecobraz client portal. The full system is free for every client: no contract, no monthly fee, no exclusivity. Access is released with the registered e-mail. Specific services — express collection, specific technical reports, data sanitisation with a report, ESG reports — are paid separately, always with conditions in writing.

A certificate any auditor validates in seconds

The destination certificate carries a QR code. Point a camera at it and the system itself confirms the document's authenticity — no phone calls to Brazil, no translation, no benefit of the doubt required. It is issued after review by environmental engineering and signed by the technically responsible professional, ready for third-party audit.

How head-office compliance verifies remotely

  • Portal access from anywhere — the records of each collection, organised by date and operation.
  • Exportable history — volumes and documents by period, ready to feed the ESG or compliance system your group already uses. The data is yours.
  • Scope in writing — materials, exclusions, responsibilities and conditions agreed before each collection, so the evidence matches what was actually carried out. How the evidence is built

How to start

  1. Describe the operation — use the collection request form or WhatsApp. The team replies within 24 business hours, in English or Portuguese.
  2. See the demonstration — online, around 30 minutes: the QR certificate validated live in front of you and the portal with sample data. No commitment.
  3. First documented collection — scheduled within 1 to 7 business days after the technical assessment, with photos and weights recorded at origin.
